scope: Commit-subject classification for Forgejo-only history from merge-base 07964e2bd61856035d10329eba7b57cfff03ff9e to ssot/main 0ea2da9b0b3b4ca61bfc5fbb263f050fa92018c8.

method.classification: Conventional commit-like first subject token; this is an orientation metric, not a semantic proof of code quality.

derived_indicators.interpretation: A high fix-to-feat ratio is a review signal only. It may represent healthy debt closure, unstable features, merge/release closure, or semantic misclassification.

required_capability_survival_cohort.unit: canonical capability/contract/surface, never raw LOC or raw commit count
required_capability_survival_cohort.failure_rule: Any unknown required evidence makes survival unknown; it must never be coerced to active.

future_metrics: proof attachment ratio for runtime changes
plan/HITL admission adherence with explained deviations
Forgejo build/artifact survival and GitHub relay read-back
anti_metrics: Do not score agents or humans by LOC, commits, tokens, or feature count.
Do not infer test coverage from a commit subject prefix.
Do not render unknown survival as a healthy capability.
Do not use ratios as automatic punishment or promotion authority.
implementation_owner: Extend the existing cynic-cli node_host_audit/source audit family with shared Git source helpers and typed capability evidence references; do not add a parallel script/dashboard.
